hook: 4 resume mistakes that get you *rejected in 6 seconds*

slides.title: A 'Objective' nobody reads
slides.body: Replace it with a 2-line summary: who you are + what you're good at + the role you want.

slides.title: Duties instead of results
slides.body: Not "Handled social media". Write "Grew the club page from 300 to 1,200 followers in 4 months" - with your real numbers.

slides.title: Photo, DOB, father's name
slides.body: Not needed for most private jobs. Use that space for projects and skills.

slides.title: One resume for every job
slides.body: Copy 3-4 keywords from each job description into your skills and summary. ATS filters look for them.
